description: Optical properties and frequency-dependent dielectric function

kpoints.rule: Dense Gamma-centered mesh for well-resolved spectra

notes: For excitonic effects use BSE (Bethe-Salpeter equation)
Scissor operator can be applied post-processing to correct band gap

NBANDS.rule: 2-3x default, need many empty bands for good spectra

workflow: TWO-STEP: 1) SCF → 2) LOPTICS calculation with many empty bands
